sections.text: Host Your Christmas Dinner at Toynbee Hall﻿
Historic London Venue for Christmas Parties & Festive Dining

Celebrate the festive season at Toynbee Hall – a beautifully restored heritage venue in the heart of East London, just minutes away from Aldgate East Underground Station. Whether you’re planning a Christmas dinner, lunch, or festive party, our elegant spaces provide the perfect setting for a memorable event.
Take a 3D virtual tour of our venue﻿
Enjoy a festive feast at Toynbee Hall

Whether you’re planning an office Christmas party, festive lunch, or three-course Christmas dinner, Toynbee Hall provides one of East London’s most memorable settings for seasonal celebrations. Enjoy a carefully crafted menu of traditional favourites and contemporary twists, served in the stunning surroundings of our historic venue – perfect for bringing people together over great food, warm conversation, and a touch of Christmas magic.
Our packages
Select one of our set packages or use the enquiry form to share your specific requirements.
CANAPES & BUBBLES

Kick off the season with a relaxed and sociable celebration. Enjoy a selection of handcrafted festive canapés paired with sparkling bubbles – perfect for team drinks, client gatherings, or a light Christmas party in one of our elegant spaces.
From £25pp
Plus VAT
CHRISTMAS DINNER

For something more traditional, indulge in our classic three-course Christmas dinner. Enjoy a festive menu of seasonal favourites, served in the timeless surroundings of Toynbee Hall – ideal for sit-down celebrations or corporate Christmas lunches.
From £30pp
Plus VAT

Frequently asked questions
WHAT IS THE CAPACITY FOR CHRISTMAS PARTIES?
We charge per person, and can cater for up to 250 people
CAN YOU PROVIDE CATERING?
Yes we have in-house caterers that provide a range of catering options
CAN WE BRING OUR OWN ENTERTAINMENT?
Yes, but it has to be pre-approved with correct licenses.
DO YOU OFFER CHARITY OR NON-PROFIT RATES?
We do! Send us an enquiry to get a quote for your christmas party
CAN WE BRING IN OUR OWN ALCOHOL?
No, all alcoholic drinks will be supplied by our in-house caterers
DO YOU HAVE GLUTEN FREE AND VEGAN OPTIONS?
Yes we cater to all dietary requirements! Please enquire today
